semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in high-end semiconductor ozone generators and ultra-high purity water heating systems, which are critical for wafer manufacturing processes.
summary: Zhuhai Zhihua Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the development and production of high-end semiconductor ozone generators and ultra-high purity water heating systems. With a strong emphasis on R&D and independent intellectual property, the company serves leading wafer fabs in Taiwan and Southeast Asia.

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company's products have been successfully applied in several leading wafer fabs in the Taiwan district.
regional_presence.Southeast Asia: Zhuhai Zhihua has established a presence in Southeast Asia, serving key customers in the region.
